stock.description: SL Gemini Energy Co. Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in heat supply business in the People's Republic of China. It is involved in the provision and distribution of heat and pipeline connection, engineering construction, and energy management services; design services, such as indoor heat operation designing and consulting services to government authorities and commercial operators; and custody and operation services to heat service providers. The company also offers rental services; and sells heat service facilities, including heat service equipment, devices, and parts to operators. In addition, the company provides heat services to residential and non-residential customers through primary and secondary distribution networks. SL Gemini Energy, was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Jiangyin, China.
